## 1. Purpose

This Addendum responds to a Proponent question submitted during the RFP question period, consistent with NREOCRC-OPR-001 Section 2.4 ("Where an apparent conflict cannot be resolved on this basis, the Design-Builder should raise the matter as a question... so that the Owner may issue a clarifying Addendum"). Except as expressly amended below, all other provisions of NREOCRC-OPR-001 (as amended by NREOCRC-ADD-01 and NREOCRC-ADD-02) remain unchanged and in full force.

## 2. Proponent Question No. 1

> "NREOCRC-ADD-02 amends Section 12.1 to increase the required standby power duration from 96 hours to 120 hours. Section 12.2 (Standby Power Sizing Reference) states that the fuel storage sizing basis is 'sized to City of North River Fuel Storage Bylaw minimum of 72 hours continuous operation, with contracted bulk refuelling capability to be arranged within 24 hours of activation.' Please confirm whether the fuel storage sizing basis in Section 12.2 is also amended to align with the 120-hour requirement in Section 12.1 as amended, or whether the 72-hour Bylaw-minimum fuel storage basis, together with the 24-hour contracted refuelling arrangement, remains the Owner's intended basis notwithstanding the extended generation-duration requirement."

## 3. Owner's Response

The Owner confirms that Section 12.1, as amended by NREOCRC-ADD-02, governs the required standby power generation duration. The Owner notes that Section 12.2 is expressly stated to be a **Sizing Reference table provided "for Design-Builder planning purposes"** (see NREOCRC-OPR-001 Section 12.2 heading) and not itself a Mandatory requirement independent of Section 12.1. The Design-Builder remains responsible for its own design and sizing of the standby power and fuel storage systems necessary to meet the Mandatory requirement in Section 12.1, as amended, in coordination with applicable municipal bylaw minimums and the Design-Builder's own contracted refuelling arrangements.

The Owner is not, at this time, issuing a revised numeric value for the fuel storage sizing basis in Section 12.2.

## 4. No Other Change

This Addendum does not amend Section 12.1 (as already amended by NREOCRC-ADD-02), Section 12.3, or Section 12.4.
